free_tier.stated: HotDebrid premium link generator is free and unlimited. HotDebrid premium leech is compatible with over +100 cloud file hosts.
free_tier.notes: The word 'unlimited' is the vendor's claim. No quota, no host list, no status page and no terms page is published, so nothing on the site can be checked against a second source.

per_object_cap.stated: There is no absurd file size limits. (vendor)

retention.stated: We will remove your file links after the premium download has finished.

egress.terms: We don't limit your download bandwidth in any way. (vendor) No allowance, no counter and no measured throughput is published.

interface_detail: One web form: paste a link, click Generate Premium Link, receive a download link. No API, no plugin, no documented endpoint.
tooling: Browser only; no extension, plugin, API or CLI is published.
chaining: Nothing here composes: without a host list a client cannot know whether a needed host is covered, and without a counter the monthly capacity cannot be planned.

limits.value: the generated premium link is 'locked to a single user IP'; no numeric limit published

limits_note: Two sibling sites, okdebrid.com and anydebrid.com, publish the same feature list, the same FAQ shape and the same 'free and unlimited' claim with different sentences (text similarity about 15%, so they are not copies). None of the three publishes a quota, a host list or a status page.
binding_note: No quota is published and none could be measured, so no constraint can be named as the one that fails first at 1 TiB/month. The absence of a published cap is itself the finding: a client cannot know where the wall is until it hits one.

identity_cost.detail: No account and no email is requested on the page; the generator takes a link only.

reliability_note: Ad-funded with no status page and no published host list, so a dead host and a banned client look the same from outside; links are IP-locked.
confidence_note: Everything recorded is the vendor's own marketing, and none of it is checkable against a second source: no host list, no limits page, no status page, no third-party report found. One successful unlock measured with a byte count would move it to measured; one third-party report to reported.

evidence.proved: 'free and unlimited', 'compatible with over +100 cloud file hosts', 'We don't limit your download bandwidth in any way', 'The provided premium link is locked to a single user IP', and the absence of any host list or numeric limit on the page

notes: Recorded as the representative of a class rather than as a measured option. okdebrid.com and anydebrid.com are separate services with the same claims and the same missing evidence; they are not counted as separate capacity. This class is why answer cannot be 'free is unlimited': the claim is free to make and unverifiable from outside.

extras.similarity_note: pairwise text similarity 0.13-0.17, so related by template and claim, not by copied text
